ev.q: Medication refill ED visits were significantly more prevalent during Hurricane Florence, compared with before (PR = 2.3; 95% CI = 1.2–4.2)
Among the 73 visits before Hurricane Florence, 25% (18) of hurricane-related ED visits were for injuries
However, among the 185 visits occurring during Hurricane Florence, 31% (58) of ED visits were for medication refills.
Medication refill ED visits were significantly more prevalent during Hurricane Florence, compared with before (PR = 2.3; 95% CI = 1.2–4.2)
After adjustment for age, sex, race, and insurance coverage, medication refill ED visits remained more prevalent during Hurricane Florence
NC DETECT was queried to identify Hurricane Florence–related ED visits, defined as ED visits during September 7–28, 2018
Percentages of ED visits in each category were compared for periods before (September 7–13), during (September 14–17), and after (September 18–28)
